title: 100STYLE backward walks
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height
speed  (a clip's header: loops that walk or run in place) how fast the capture travelled, percent of standing hip height a second

100STYLE.origin: The 100STYLE dataset: one performer walking, running, sidestepping and idling in 100 styles, captured by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura (Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases, 2022). Each clip is a backward walk cut at its best cycle, facing forward and stepping back, inside the frames the dataset marks as the style.

Aeroplane_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, aeroplane style: both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side

Akimbo_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, akimbo style: hands on hips

Angry_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, angry style: swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed

ArmsAboveHead_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, arms above head style: arms raised straight above head

ArmsBehindBack_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, arms behind back style: hands clasped behind back

ArmsBySide_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, arms by side style: keep arms fixed by side and do not move them

ArmsFolded_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, arms folded style: right arm folded over left

Balance_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, balance style: arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side

BeatChest_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, beat chest style: beat chest while moving normally

BentForward_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, bent forward style: tilt torso forwards

BentKnees_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, bent knees style: bend knees as much as possible

BigSteps_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, big steps style: as large steps as possible

BouncyLeft_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, bouncy left style: step normally with right foot but spring off left foot

BouncyRight_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, bouncy right style: step normally with left foot but spring off right foot

Cat_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, cat style: use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot

Chicken_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, chicken style: bob head - arms as wings

Depressed_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, depressed style: head bowed arms swinging

Dinosaur_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, dinosaur style: like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture

DragLeftLeg_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, drag left leg style: drag left foot along the floor

DragRightLeg_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, drag right leg style: drag right foot along the floor

DuckFoot_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, duck foot style: toes pointing inwards

Heavyset_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, heavyset style: walking as a muscle man tensed biceps

HighKnees_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, high knees style: lift knees high but only knees – not marching

Kick_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, kick style: kick with every step

LeanBack_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, lean back style: bent backwards

LeanLeft_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, lean left style: normal motion upperbody tilted right

LeftHop_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, left hop style: hop on left foot

LimpRight_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, limp right style: keep right leg straight and limp

Monk_WalkBack.desc: Walking backward, monk style: interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed
